## Copper Dragon, Very Young (CR 6)

**XP** 2,400  
 CG Small dragon (earth)  
 **Init** +6; **Senses** dragon senses; Perception +12  

**Defense**

 **AC** 20, touch 13, flat-footed 18 (+2 Dex, +7 natural, +1 size)  
 **hp** 59 (7d12+14)  
 **Fort** +7, **Ref** +7, **Will** +7  
 **Immune** acid, paralysis, sleep  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft., fly 150 ft. (average); climb stone  
 **Melee** bite +10 (1d6+3/19–20), 2 claws +10 (1d4+2)  
 **Special Attacks** breath weapon (40-ft. line, DC 15, 4d6 acid), slow breath  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 7th; concentration +9)  

  At will—*[grease](../../magic/spells/grease.md)* (DC 13)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 15, **Dex** 14, **Con** 15, **Int** 14, **Wis** 15, **Cha** 14  
 **Base Atk** +7; **CMB** +8; **CMD** 20 (24 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** Combat Expertise, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Initiative, Power Attack  
 **Skills** Bluff +12, Craft (traps) +12, Fly +14, Perception +12, Perform (comedy) +9, Sense Motive +12, Stealth +16, Use Magic Device +12  
 **Languages** Common, Draconic, Gnome  

**Special Abilities**

 **Climb Stone (Ex)** A copper dragon can climb on stone surfaces as though using the *spider climb* spell.  

 **Slow Breath (Su)** Instead of a line of acid, a copper dragon can breathe a cone of slowing gas. Those in the cone must make a Fortitude save or be slowed (as per the spell *slow*) for 1d6 rounds plus 1 round per age category of the dragon.

**Ecology**

Environment
